import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; import { CheckCircle, Train, Home } from "lucide-react"; import "./Confirmation.css"; function fmt(n) { return `PKR ${n.toLocaleString("en-PK")}`; } export default function Confirmation() { const [booking, setBooking] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { const data = localStorage.getItem("lastBooking"); if (data) setBooking(JSON.parse(data)); }, []); if (!booking) { return (

No booking found

Go Home
); } return (

Booking Confirmed!

Your tickets have been booked successfully. A confirmation will be sent to your email.

Booking Reference: {booking.ref}

Booking Summary

{booking.bookings.map((b, i) => (
{b.route.trainNumber} {b.route.trainName}
{b.route.departureTime} {b.route.from}
{b.route.arrivalTime} {b.route.to}
Date: {b.travelDate} Class: {b.seatClass} Fare: {fmt(b.fare.total)}
))}

Passenger

{booking.passenger.name}

{booking.passenger.email}

{booking.passenger.phone}

Total Paid {fmt(booking.total)}
Back to Home Book Another Train
); }
